messages:
ravi_cs: Greenleaf onboarding call just finished (30m). They raised 3 product asks + one onboarding blocker. Renewal in ~7 weeks — flagging as higher priority. Consolidated notes below.

Dionne_cs: Quick list: 1) embeddings staleness — search returns old content after dataset update (customer: 'we're seeing 24+hr lag'). 2) per-route cost visibility — finance needs per-route billing attribution. 3) per-route RBAC — teams want to lock routes. Onboarding blocker: bulk user invite/token limits are confusing for admins. Filed ticket CS-4821.

opsbot: Ticket CS-4821 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821 — tags: customer:greenleaf, priority: P2

elena_prod: Thanks — can you paste the example query that returns stale embeddings? Is this immediately after upload or after reindex? Also: is caching enabled on their side or ours?

ravi_cs: Customer says they re-uploaded asset and re-indexed via Console, saw old results for ~18 hours. Example query they ran: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -d '{"route":"kb-product","query":"How do I configure per-route billing?"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` They also toggled cache:false in debug mode with no change.

sam_pm: If this is a KV cache invalidation issue on reindex, it could explain the lag. @elena_prod any quick triage thoughts? If it's a ~1-2 day fix we should consider a hotfix before renewal conversations. :thinking_face:

elena_prod: I'll triage. Quick asks: (a) can CS reproduce consistently? (b) was there a traffic spike at reindex time? (c) can we get the reindex event logs and timestamps? Also need to categorize impact — blocking vs UX annoyance.

dionne_cs: I'll request logs and exact timestamps (they reported reindex ~2026-02-18T16:32Z). Repro steps they gave: upload -> reindex -> search same query -> old results. Impact note: blocks shipping 2 paid features for them. Marking this as 'renewal risk' until we confirm.

elena_prod: :eyes: If logs show runtime didn't invalidate KV cache on model/index update, we can add invalidation on reindex. Quick estimate: 2 engineers, ~3 days for safe rollout + monitoring. Per-route cost visibility is a separate UX + billing effort — need a short requirements doc from CS/product ops.

ravi_cs: Created a short requirements doc in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/greenleaf-per-route-cost. Initial prioritization suggestion from CS: Embedding staleness = P0 (renewal risk), Per-route cost visibility = P1, RBAC per-route = P2, Onboarding token UX = P2.

sam_pm: I'll slot Embedding staleness into next sprint triage. @elena_prod can you confirm patch ETA after triage? If we can push a temporary ops workaround (cache flush / manual invalidation) that might buy time for renewal.

elena_prod: I'll confirm after triage today. Workaround: we have an internal cache-invalidate endpoint we can run for them as emergency ops action. If logs confirm KV TTL issue, quick fix should be possible.

dionne_cs: Thanks — I'll gather logs and ask Greenleaf for permission to run the invalidate. They want weekly updates until resolved; adding to CS watchlist.

ravi_cs: Agreed. I'll post weekly status updates and follow up with Solutions for a runbook if we do a manual invalidate. @sam_pm please loop in Solutions/Support for the temporary runbook. :thumbsup:
